name: searchable-pdf-text-layer-alignment-pytesseract-dpi
alt: Text-layer overlays: with --dpi 300 words sit 0.71 pt from their true spot on A4; without it the page is 2551.89 pt wide
caption: Without a DPI, pytesseract's PDF assumes 70 DPI and makes a 35 × 50-inch page; with config="--dpi 300" the hidden words land on the A4 scan. Synthetic test scan.
machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 runner, Intel Xeon 6975P-C, 4 vCPU
